statements.status_notes: GitLab Runner includes the GitLab-maintained docker-machine binary for machine executor workflows. CVE-2023-40453 affects Docker Machine through 0.16.2 when attacker-controlled worker node version data is rendered or processed, and no fixed docker-machine release is currently available for the shipped 0.16.2-gitlab.46 line. Reachability through GitLab Runner's machine executor usage remains under investigation.
